figures.finding: Federal child-labour law reaches the Virgin Islands (the Fair Labor Standards Act's 'State' includes any territory or possession) but exempts any child employed as an actor or performer in film, theatre, radio or television, so federal law sets no age, hours or permit for a child performer there; the exemption names performers only, so a child engaged to write or direct stays under the federal child-labour rules. Whether the Virgin Islands Code sets its own rule for child performers was not read (see blockers).
